q: How should a factory count emissions from a park's zero liquid discharge effluent plant?
title: Park ZLD effluent plant: which scope
short: If the park operates the plant and charges you a fee, its energy and treatment emissions are your Scope 3, Category 5, shared by your volume of effluent. Ask the park for kWh and chemicals per kilolitre treated. If your factory runs its own treatment, the energy is your Scope 1 and 2.
audience: Factories in Hawassa and other parks with central effluent treatment, and brands auditing them

p: Zero liquid discharge uses evaporators and reverse osmosis, which take a lot of energy per kilolitre. On a clean grid the CO2 is modest, but on a diesel backup it is not.

ul: Your share of volume by month.

p: Effluent volume readings and park invoices.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity, fuel and boiler invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record per factory, so the figures a brand asks for can be traced back to the bills.
